headline: Six Fronts Surge as Casualties Climb and Bases Swap
war_summary: Over the past fourteen hours the bloodletting has deepened on the six principal fronts. Callahans Passage has accumulated an additional 8,300 Colonial and 9,000 Warden dead, 712 new enlistees and 25 ownership changes, with two flips in the last two hours. Weathered Expanse added roughly 12,000 Colonial and 16,600 Warden casualties, 445 recruits and 25 base swaps, four in the last two hours. Nevish Line saw 5,200 Colonial and 4,400 Warden losses, 799 enlistees and 20 flips, none in the last two hours. Stonecradle recorded 5,700 Colonial and 8,200 Warden dead, 631 recruits and 13 flips, two in the last two hours. Linn Mercy added 1,750 Colonial and 4,560 Warden casualties, 581 recruits and five flips, two recent. Mooring County reported 4,300 Colonial and 3,800 Warden dead, 718 enlistees and five flips, one recent. Elsewhere the map remains largely static with only minor casualty drift and no ownership movement.
